run_export_depth_images: run the scannet reader to export depth images from a .sens file to an output folder
run_export_color_images: run the scannet reader to export color images from a .sens file to an output folder
run_export_poses: run the scannet reader to export camera poses from a .sens file to an output folder
run_export_intrinsics: run the scannet reader to export camera intrinsics from a .sens file to an output folder
run_export_all_data: run the scannet reader to export depth images, color images, poses, and intrinsics from a .sens file
